'''DecipherCon 1999 Iron Man''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Joe Alread]] won, out of 8 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw11_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Iron Man], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031231930/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
